finding: WAVE2B (2026-10-01) re-run: printed 'Target player draws cards equal to half the number of cards in their library and loses half their life. Round up each time.' The spell carries a TARGET_PLAYER slot; a pack cast op cannot designate a PLAYER through cast targets (harness resolves targets via the pack-key handle map and validates against spell_target_slots), and with zero designations the cast raises 'selection:count_below_min:0<1'. The enter-op 'player:1' decision lane (meteorite precedent) does not apply to a cast. Target-player designation on the cast lane is the missing harness/API surface.
